links.comparator_used: Original, more complex informed consent form for labor induction with oxytocin (readability before vs after GAI simplification)
links.outcome: Readability of consent form (Flesch Reading Ease; target 8th-grade level)
links.effect: Flesch Reading Ease scores reported as improved and meeting recommended health literacy levels; no numeric scores given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Human oversight remains critical to ensure AI-generated content adheres to legal and ethical standards; expert refinement was needed alongside iterative prompts.
links.quote: Flesch Reading Ease scores show improved readability, meeting recommended levels for health literacy.

design_hint: reading-level constraint with expert review of AI-generated consent
